title: Submagic alternative: captions for $19 once, not monthly
description: Submagic starts at $19 a month. Captions costs $19 once and works on your device: no upload, no account. English only. Free up to 60 seconds with a mark.
ogTitle: A Submagic alternative if captions are all you need
ogDescription: AI captions, made on your device. $19 once, not $19 a month.
h1: A Submagic alternative if captions are all you need
sub: AI captions, made on your device. One payment.
body: Submagic starts at $19 a month, or $12 a month paid yearly, for 15 videos of up to two minutes ([their pricing page](https://www.submagic.co/pricing), 19 September 2026). Here you pay $19 once: no monthly bill, no video count.
not: English only; Submagic captions many languages.
No extra footage, zooms or sound effects.
No cutting long videos into shorts.

questions.a: You can try it without a card, their pricing page says. Its plans start at $19 a month, or $12 a month paid yearly, for 15 videos of up to two minutes each, read on 19 September 2026. Here, clips up to 60 seconds are free with a small mark.
No. One payment of $19, and nothing renews.
Free clips carry a small smaverk.com mark in the corner. The paid version has none.
